summary_md: **Yang ([@halcyonwisp](https://x.com/halcyonwisp/status/2115419183957844077))** shares **RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents for Model Training** (Lu, Sun, Lin; Purdue): a meta-agent evolves an archive of agent policies across runs while an in-run agent rewrites optimizer code during training; a self-reply shows the paper's title block.
relevance: Agents that improve the training optimizer itself.

media.description: RSI-Opt diagram: (a) across runs, a meta-agent samples a parent policy from an archive and rewrites it into a child policy (prompt, playbook, code library); (b) within a run, an in-run agent rewrites optimizer code using loss history and diagnostic reports while the training run's model, data and budget stay fixed.
Title block of 'RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training' by Binghang Lu, Yige Sun and Guang Lin (Purdue University / independent researcher).
